info.title: Mortred Model Server API
info.description: Unified HTTP API for Mortred model servers. Model endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when auth_token is configured. Request envelope: {req_id, images[], params, options}; response envelope: {status, status_str, task_id, model, results[], server_time_ms, partial}. The legacy img_data field was removed: it answers 422 with a migration hint.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Only POST is allowed on model paths

ValidationError.description: Strict envelope rejection: errors[] carries JSON pointers

RateLimited.description: Per-item queue backpressure or per-client-IP rate limit

InternalError.description: Model or server error (per-item failures keep their own results[].status)
